title: February event: a tic-tac uses hills to hide from the sensors

tellings.quote: And, for example, during our February event we had an object of the 2nd class, which demonstrated very strange behavior, which you have never seen before didn't see. He actually used hills to hide from us and disappear from our main sensors.
But on the fifth the day the obstacles were constant throughout two hours.

as_told.title: Day five: two hours of interference, then a class 2 'tic-tac' and a 'manta ray' found hiding behind terrain
as_told.place_text: Skywatcher field site, about 800 m up and 800 m away

plain: At a February 2025 field event run by Skywatcher, a startup that says it can summon UFOs, the team says a tic tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint, ducked behind hills to escape their instruments. James Valor, who was there, tells Michels it was what they call a second class object that "demonstrated very strange behavior": "He actually used hills to hide from us and disappear from our main sensors." He credits a colleague named Proixel. The Skywatcher team, telling it on the same episode and crediting a member named Jordan Jose, adds that on the fifth day there was interference "constant throughout two hours", and that an object shaped like a manta ray also hid behind the terrain. If true, it would mean these objects behave as if they understand they are being watched and act to avoid it.
